CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(CPR_Issuance_Date__c), NULL, DATE( YEAR(CPR_Issuance_Date__c) + 2, MONTH(CPR_Issuance_Date__c), MIN( DAY(CPR_Issuance_Date__c), CASE( MONTH(CPR_Issuance_Date__c), 2, IF( MOD(YEAR(CPR_Issuance_Date__c) + 2, 400) = 0 || ( MOD(YEAR(CPR_Issuance_Date__c) + 2, 4) = 0 && MOD(YEAR(CPR_Issuance_Date__c) + 2, 100) <> 0 ), 29, 28 ), 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ) ) ) )
